EES1.label: New user registration or registration ID request

EES1.1.label: New user registration or registration ID request
EES1.1.description: Definition: An organisation, account manager or user asks for Embase accounts to be created for named people: new registration IDs and passcodes, login credentials, adding a user, or how a new colleague gets an account. Includes the agent sending out registration credentials.

EES2.label: Remove, revoke or delete a user account

EES2.1.label: Remove, revoke or delete a user account
EES2.1.description: Definition: A user must lose access or their account must go: deactivate or revoke a user who has left, delete a user from an organisation account, or permanently delete an Elsevier account.

EES3.label: Change or transfer the email on an account or licence

EES3.1.label: Change or transfer the email on an account or licence
EES3.1.description: Definition: The email address on an existing account is no longer valid or must change, or a licence or seat held under one email address must move to another person or address.

EES4.label: Verification or login-details email not received

EES4.1.label: Verification or login-details email not received
EES4.1.description: Definition: An email the customer needs in order to register or sign in has not arrived: the Embase email verification notice or code, a password reset email or code, or promised login details or registration credentials.

EES5.label: Personal account not linked to the institution or organisation

EES5.1.label: Personal account not linked to the institution or organisation
EES5.1.description: Definition: The customer has a personal Elsevier account but it is not linked, or is wrongly linked, to the institution or organisation that holds the Embase access: redirected back to the start page, no institution found, linking a personal account broke institutional access, access via the organisation email or access code does not work, or users are now required to register a personal account under SSO or email-domain access.

EES6.1.label: Sign-in problem with registered credentials
EES6.1.description: Definition: The customer has registered credentials but cannot sign in with them - an error with an ID and passcode or email and password - or can sign in but no longer sees what belongs to the account, such as saved searches or email alerts.

EES7.1.label: Other email-account issue
EES7.1.description: Definition: An email-account or registration problem that fits none of the sub-categories above.
